roles.name: Production Orchestrator
roles.responsibility: Routes tasks through the pipeline, maintains global state, enforces budgets, supervises loops.

roles.name: System Architect
roles.responsibility: System structure, component boundaries, interface contracts, schema designs.

roles.name: Software Engineer
roles.responsibility: Implementation in designated languages and frameworks without seeing holdout scenarios.

roles.name: Adversarial Reviewer
roles.responsibility: Cross-checking outputs against specifications, holdouts, regressions, and prior decisions.

roles.name: Test & QA Engineer
roles.responsibility: Scenario generation, property-based testing, edge cases, load simulation.

roles.name: Security Auditor
roles.responsibility: Static analysis, threat modeling, dependency scanning, secret leakage prevention.

roles.name: Documentation Agent
roles.responsibility: API docs, runbooks, changelogs, user-facing guides — produced before deploy as a blocker.

roles.name: Compliance & Governance Agent
roles.responsibility: Regulatory alignment, audit trails, data governance, invariant monitoring.

roles.name: Deployment Operator
roles.responsibility: Deterministic build verification, environment sync, git release, incident alerting.
